Enterprise Grade Security Core

Uncompromising standards mapped to mobile realities.

👁️

Biometric Edge-cases

Anticipates Biometric Failures (Sensor dirty / Wet hands) by invoking secure PIN fallbacks linked through expo-secure-store ensuring offline auth.

✍️

Invalid Signature Rejection

Within batches simulating malicious entries or attacks, invalid EIP-712 transaction signatures are gracefully rejected natively by the Smart Contracts.

🛑

Idempotent Hooks

Idempotency middleware intercepts duplicate Daraja requests instantly, ensuring zero possibility of inflationary double-minting.
